description: B1: methods at matched query budget (see the module docstring of code/exp_twirls.py)

config.sampling_votes: k = Q samples from softmax(logits) at temperature 1 (float16 cached logits)

concat.inner_tie_rule: three distinct orbit votes -> the first vote

config.ensemble: split_seed 0, init_seed 0..4; plurality of the five argmax tables (tie = failure), and argmax of the mean logits
config.tie_rule: a tie for first place is a failure
config.grok_rule: add/grok p=47 snapshot with eps closest to each target (ties: smallest id), over all 360 snapshots of the 12 runs
config.exact_method: plur_fail(): multinomial plurality failure of the exactly enumerated channel of every input; absolute accuracy ~1e-12 per input; where mean_err < 1e-11 quote chernoff_mean_upper (a rigorous upper bound) instead
config.unit_note: models sharing a split or an initialisation are not independent; n = 7 models per configuration = 5 initialisations of split 0 + splits 1, 2 at initialisation 0
